title: latest_invoice.payment_intent is gone, so a new subscription has no client_secret to confirm
symptoms: expand latest_invoice.payment_intent returns an invoice with no payment_intent field
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'client_secret')
Payment Element never mounts for a payment_behavior default_incomplete subscription
cause: Basil added partial payments on invoices and removed payment_intent, charge, paid and paid_out_of_band from Invoice, and invoice from PaymentIntent and Charge. Tutorials written before 2025 still expand the old path.
fix: Expand latest_invoice.confirmation_secret and hand its client_secret to the Payment Element. To link payments and invoices, read invoice.payments or the Invoice Payments list endpoint.
affected: Stripe API 2025-03-31.basil and later; stripe-node 18+ and the matching majors of other SDKs
